_comment: SD pre-reduce EWL — TAIL-GUARD arm.  One functional key over _sdewl_on30.json:
Isolates ONE question: was the +6.8% ev1 lift of the unguarded arm the 2.3% of rows
carrying a pathological x_lin?  Measured |resid_m| on that arm: median 1.02, p90 3.50,
p95 5.04, p99 1349, max 1.85e6 m — at a 0.08 m row sigma, the tail is astronomically
over-weighted garbage and could manufacture the whole lift on its own.  A 10 m ceiling
keeps 96.5% of rows and drops the tail.
If ev1 keeps ~+6% the lift is real structure; if it collapses toward the wl1off 0.1390
plateau, the lift WAS the tail.
